summary_1line: A sage begins recounting Ravana’s lineage, describing the ascetic Pulastya whose curse causes Trinabindu’s daughter to conceive, leading toward the birth of Vishravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Pulastya sits in deep austerity on Mount Meru as carefree maidens sing and dance in the forest, disturbing his meditation.
Pulastya angrily declares that any maiden who comes under his gaze will conceive instantly, his ascetic power blazing as the girls flee in terror.
Trinabindu’s daughter approaches the meditating sage while he recites the Veda, and suddenly she turns pale as the signs of pregnancy appear.
